qa_pairs.question: Which component types use the lever to pedal value sender specification?
What vehicle types does the pedal value sender to pedal console specification apply to?
Which sender specification has the higher torque requirement?
qa_pairs.answer: The lever to pedal value sender (1AZ) has the higher torque requirement at 9 Nm compared to 5 Nm for the pedal value sender to pedal console (2AZ).
